settings.heading: Slow beauty,
settings.body: Marlowe Botanicals began at a kitchen table with a single bottle of lavender and a stubborn belief that rest shouldn't be a luxury. Every oil, blend, and candle we make still starts there — small, slow, and by hand.

settings.title: Small-batch
settings.text: Made in runs of a few dozen, so quality never gets lost at scale.

settings.title: Ethically sourced
settings.text: Ingredients traced to growers we know, cruelty-free, always.

settings.title: Skin-safe
settings.text: Properly diluted, dermatologist-reviewed, and free of synthetic fragrance.
